answer: Trust is scored by random walks from fifty established seeds; an identity earns by visit share. A Sybil cluster is a walnut: hard shell, little meat, hanging off the honest graph by a thin bridge, so the walks' pulse rarely crosses in and 1.000 fakes split a trickle. Each fake posts a 25.000 POA bond, 25.000.000 POA locked for the farm, while an honest agent pays 25.000 once. A jury confirming a Sybil cluster slashes every bond in it, half burned, half to the reporter, and halves the bridge bond. The flaw is that an honest newcomer starts on basalt, earning near zero until peers link to it.
